error.not_configured: Grafana URL or API token not set. Configure them in Settings → Plugins → Grafana Alerts.
error.unauthorized: Grafana rejected the token (401/403). Check the service account token and its role.
error.parse: Could not parse the Grafana response

grafana_url.label: Grafana URL
grafana_url.description: Base URL of your Grafana, e.g. https://grafana.example.com

api_token.label: API token
api_token.description: Service account token (Administration → Service accounts, role Viewer is enough).

ignore_datasource_alerts.label: Ignore datasource alerts
ignore_datasource_alerts.description: Hide the built-in DatasourceNoData / DatasourceError alerts.

hidden_labels.label: Hidden labels
hidden_labels.description: Labels not shown as tags in the panel (internal __ labels are always hidden).

hide_when_zero.label: Hide when empty
hide_when_zero.description: Hide the bar widget when no alert is firing.
